answer_1.quote: We treat replies containing multiple intents as unique intents in their own right as it is unclear that a user would accept a suggestion that only partially contained the desired intents.

answer_2.quote: We employ both automatic and human evaluation. ROUGE-L, which has been used previously in AI writing tasks, measures the longest common subsequence within the prediction, capturing surface-level overlap with the ground-truth.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: You will be shown a target reply and two candidate replies. Select which candidate reply is most similar to the target reply. Similar means having the same semantic meaning.
